name: SVN-Server
description: Apache Subversion (SVN) is an open-source version control system that manages files and directories, and the changes made to them, over time. This container runs svnserve as a standalone daemon on port 3690.

notes.text: Create a repository with `svnadmin create /srv/svn/<name>` inside the container.
To enable authenticated commits, edit `/srv/svn/<name>/conf/svnserve.conf` (set `anon-access = read`, `auth-access = write`, `password-db = passwd`) and add users to `/srv/svn/<name>/conf/passwd`.
